slice: memory lifecycle completion plus deterministic cross-domain derivation recompute/invalidation
purpose: Complete the controlled memory lifecycle (explicit logical forget, lifecycle read-only policy) without creating a second body authority, and make source changes (memory operation, relationship record, emotion record, personality profile) deterministically invalidate or recompute dependent cognition/emotion/relationship derivations inside the same DB transaction, so old captures/reads can never resurrect a withdrawn source.

implementation.derivationModel: explicit deterministic source derivation states current/needs_review/degraded/source_invalid/revoked with bounded reasons (version_changed/source_missing/source_revoked/source_unavailable/source_merged/source_not_current/record_withdrawn); capture metadata carries derivation+reasons; bodyAvailable only for current/degraded; validateForView compares authority, recordDigest and derivation; derivedRevision participates in authority and ReadView inner authority checks; old captures/bodies are rejected.
implementation.crossDomainSources: INNER_SOURCE_KINDS adds relationship-record / emotion-record / personality-profile; each domain exposes a read-only sourceReference resolver with 4-level cycle protection (fail closed); writing against a source whose version changed is rejected with INNER_SOURCE_NOT_CURRENT; withdrawn/forgotten sources never revive. relationship merge maps source_merged and split deterministically restores current; personality only an active profile may be a source; digested emotion observations are not current.
implementation.transaction: Worker wraps the four inner-domain write commands and memory.withdrawLocal/forgetLocal in an outer transaction and triggers recomputeInnerDomains inside the same DB transaction; a digest change persists the derivation ledger and bumps derivedRevision exactly once (no change = no write/no bump); read-only *.derivations and *.recompute IPC commands are added.
implementation.memoryLifecycle: memory.forgetLocal (consent -> withdrawn + forgottenAt + deletion tombstone; shares the withdraw barrier and is individually idempotent) plus read-only memory.lifecycle (owner-controlled, automaticExpiry=false, physicalErase=false, deletion watermark/readability/publishability); publication keeps schema4 six-domain capabilities and does not overstate verification.

verification.positive: withdraw -> dependent derivation degraded/source_revoked; old capture and readInnerBodies rejected; forget is idempotent and reports the logical policy; publication unchanged; personality version -> needs_review and old capture rejected; relationship merge -> needs_review and split -> deterministic current restore without rewriting history; emotion withdrawal -> degraded/revokedEvidence; recompute idempotent, restart-durable, two connections = one revision bump.
verification.negative: old version sources are rejected before write (INNER_SOURCE_NOT_CURRENT), withdrawn/forgotten sources cannot be reused or revived, stale captures fail validation, no-op recompute does not bump the revision, publication capabilities/verification are never promoted.

failedUnknownUntested: Retention is explicit logical lifecycle only; no background expiry, physical erase, backup-deletion propagation or index vacuum cleanup.
Recompute is a bounded same-DB latest scan; cross-component state is explicit unknown rather than a cross-service atomic snapshot.
Old records without derivation fields normalize to current (meaning "never computed"), not re-proof.
No real model/embedding/host reload/real Ombre in this slice; cross-domain semantic re-derivation by a model is not attempted and never authoritative.
evidenceLevel: G1 module/integration + real temporary SQLite/Worker IPC; not host or business acceptance.

migrationFix.symptom: the fixed host failed to re-activate after the H4e slice: the additive migration used ALTER TABLE on inner meta tables that are already covered by commit-watermark triggers, so the trigger SQL no longer matched the new column list and every tracked transaction failed closed (STORE_ISOLATED).
migrationFix.rootCause: commit-watermark trigger SQL embeds the tracked column list; altering a tracked table inside an owned atomic() cannot reconcile an existing trigger definition, so the upgrade aborted and the plugin never activated.
migrationFix.fix: the derivation authority now lives in a separate additive table (<domain>_derivation_meta); inner meta tables are never altered, so the upgrade is purely additive and the watermark installs triggers for the new table only. meta()/saveMeta read and write the joined derivation row; the derivation ledger table is unchanged.
migrationFix.regressionTest: tests/inner-upgrade.test.ts creates a pre-H4e on-disk inner schema, opens the current ControlStore (additive upgrade), asserts the meta columns stay unchanged, the derivation authority starts at 0/'', and a second open proves the tracking triggers still match.
migrationFix.evidence: reproduced on a copy of the live control DB: before the fix every open failed with the quarantined error; after the fix the copy upgraded and reopened twice, then the real host activated successfully.
